do: Body text must hit 4.5:1 against its background (3:1 for >=24px or bold >=19px)
dont: Ship gray-on-gray below 4.5:1
why: Low contrast text is unreadable for low vision users and in bright light.

do: Keep a visible focus indicator on every interactive element
dont: Remove the focus outline with no replacement
why: Keyboard users need to see which control has focus.

do: Give icon-only controls an accessible name
dont: Ship an icon button with no label
why: A screen reader announces nothing for an unlabeled icon button.

do: Describe meaningful images; mark decorative ones empty
dont: Omit the alt attribute
why: Screen readers and broken-image fallbacks depend on alt text.

rule: Color is not the only signal
do: Pair color with text or an icon to convey state
dont: Convey success or error by color alone
why: Color blind users miss state that is shown by color alone.

do: Use one h1 and never skip heading levels
dont: Jump from h2 to h4 for styling
why: Assistive tech builds the document outline from heading levels.

do: Associate every input with a real label
dont: Use a placeholder as the only label
why: A placeholder vanishes on input and is not a label for assistive tech.

do: Make tap targets at least 44x44px
dont: Ship 24px tap targets on mobile
why: Small targets are hard to hit on touch screens.

do: Leave >=8px between adjacent targets
dont: Pack interactive elements edge to edge
why: Adjacent targets with no gap cause mistaps.

rule: Hover is not the only path
do: Expose actions without requiring hover
dont: Hide primary actions behind hover only
why: Touch and keyboard users cannot hover to reveal actions.

do: Serve WebP or AVIF with fallbacks
dont: Ship hero images as uncompressed PNG/JPG
why: WebP and AVIF cut image bytes by half or more.

do: Set width/height or aspect-ratio to prevent CLS
dont: Let images reflow layout on load
why: Images with no dimensions shift the layout as they load.

do: Defer offscreen images
dont: Eager-load every image on the page
why: Eager-loading offscreen images delays the first paint.

do: Keep content within the viewport width
dont: Set fixed px widths wider than small screens
why: Fixed widths wider than the screen force sideways scrolling on mobile.

do: Let users pinch-zoom
dont: Disable zoom in the viewport meta
why: Blocking zoom fails low vision users.

do: Set base body text to >=16px
dont: Use 12px body copy
why: Body text under 16px strains reading on mobile.

do: Cap measure around 65-75 characters
dont: Let paragraphs run the full window width
why: Lines beyond about 75 characters are hard to track.

do: Reference semantic tokens in components
dont: Hardcode raw hex in components
why: Hardcoded hex defeats theming and consistency.

do: Tint neutrals slightly toward the brand hue
dont: Use #000 for large surfaces
why: Pure black on large surfaces looks harsh and smears on OLED.

do: Keep UI feedback between 150 and 300ms
dont: Animate UI feedback longer than 300ms
why: UI feedback over 300ms feels sluggish.

do: Honor prefers-reduced-motion
dont: Animate regardless of user preference
why: Motion triggers nausea for users with a vestibular disorder.

do: Animate transform and opacity
dont: Animate width/height/top/left
why: Animating layout properties forces reflow and drops frames.

do: Show errors next to the field
dont: Show errors only at the top of the form
why: An error far from its field is hard to connect to the cause.

do: Indicate the current page or section
dont: Render all nav links identically
why: Users need to know which page or section they are on.

do: Add labels or patterns beyond color
dont: Encode chart series by color alone
why: Color alone excludes color blind readers from a chart.

do: Pair type, inputmode and autocomplete so codes and amounts raise the numeric keyboard
dont: Use type="number" for codes, IDs or one-time codes
why: The wrong input type raises the wrong keyboard for codes and amounts.

do: Show nothing under 300ms, a skeleton from 300ms to 2s, a spinner with a contextual message beyond 2s
dont: Flash a skeleton on instant loads or leave a bare spinner on long waits
why: A flashed skeleton or a bare spinner reads as jank.

do: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to any target="_blank" link
dont: Open a new tab without rel and expose window.opener
why: target=_blank without rel exposes window.opener to the new tab.

do: Insert user or remote content with textContent, or sanitize before innerHTML
dont: Assign an untrusted string to innerHTML
why: Assigning untrusted input to innerHTML is a cross-site scripting hole.

do: Keep API keys and tokens behind a server or proxy
dont: Embed a private key in shipped JavaScript
why: A key shipped in client JavaScript is public.

do: Defer or async scripts, or place them at the end of body
dont: Load a render-blocking script in the head
why: A render-blocking script in the head delays the first paint.

do: Declare font-display: swap so text shows immediately
dont: Block text rendering on the web font download
why: Without font-display swap the text stays invisible during the font download.

do: Catch fetch errors and render a recovery path
dont: Await a fetch with no error handling
why: An unhandled fetch rejection leaves the user on a blank state.

do: Design empty, loading and error states, not only the populated one
dont: Render only the happy path
why: Only the happy path leaves the empty and error views undesigned.

do: Guard nested optional fields before access
dont: Read deep fields without a guard
why: Reading a deep field with no guard throws on missing data.

do: Use button for actions and a for links
dont: Attach a click handler to a div or span
why: A div with a click handler is not focusable or announced as a control.

do: Strip console logging and dead code from the artifact
dont: Ship console.log and commented-out code
why: console.log and dead code ship weight and leak internals.

do: Return a generic error page in production
dont: Expose stack traces or framework error pages
why: Stack traces reveal framework, versions and file paths that guide an attacker.

do: Keep auth tokens in httpOnly cookies
dont: Store a session token in localStorage
why: localStorage is readable by any script so an XSS can steal the token.

do: Map or parse data instead of evaluating it
dont: Pass a string to eval or new Function
why: eval on tainted input is remote code execution.

do: Wrap JSON.parse in try/catch or validate first
dont: Call JSON.parse on a response with no guard
good_code: try { data = JSON.parse(text) } catch { data = null }
why: A malformed response throws and takes down the render.

do: Remove listeners and clear timers on teardown
dont: Add listeners that are never removed
why: Orphaned listeners and timers leak memory and fire on dead nodes.

do: Ship an @media print block
dont: Leave printing and PDF export unstyled
why: Without it printed and PDF output wastes ink and hides link targets.

do: Provide a skip link that appears on focus
dont: Ship an sr-only skip link that never becomes visible
why: A keyboard user needs a visible skip link to jump past navigation.

do: Declare the supported color schemes
dont: Leave native controls locked to one theme
why: Native controls and scrollbars follow the page theme instead of clashing.

do: Degrade JS-dependent UI with noscript
dont: Hide content that only appears once JS runs
why: Content hidden until JS runs is invisible when a script fails.
